subject: POC plan: model palette selection & evaluation milestones
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@lumenhealth.com>, Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: POC plan: model palette selection & evaluation milestones

Hi Maria / Carlos — thanks again for today's call. Quick recap and a proposed POC plan so we can confirm scope and owners. I tried to keep this tight so we can agree next steps quickly.

Summary of needs (from call)
- Primary workload: clinical note summarization + structured extraction (diagnoses, meds, follow-ups).
- Languages: English primary, Spanish secondary (10% of traffic), occasional French (2%).
- Constraints: sub-300ms target median latency, strict PHI handling, US data residency, HIPAA BAA required.

Proposed model palette for trial (open / cost-efficient options)
- Primary candidate: Llama-3-70B (8-bit) — chosen for best mix of instruction-following and long-context handling.
- Fallback / cost mode: Mistral-Instruct-7B (8-bit) — fast and smaller, will be used for low-cost bulk runs and as a fallback when capacity constrained.
- Multilingual checks: small LLM adapter layer (mBART-lite) for Spanish/French pre/post-processing; we will include targeted prompt templates per locale.

Success criteria (ready for you to edit)
- Quality: 90% of sample clinical notes must have summary quality >= 4/5 by your SME rubric (we'll ship an initial rubric).
- Accuracy on structured extraction: precision >= 92% for medications and diagnoses on the sampled test set.
- Performance: median latency < 300ms, 95th percentile < 700ms for the primary model under expected concurrency.
- Cost: per-record inference cost <= $0.12 (target) averaged across the trial.

Proposed POC timeline (6 weeks)
- Week 0 (this week): Agree scope, sign BAA, share initial sample data (anonymized).
- Week 1: Redwood provides eval prompt set + test harness + baseline runs on 200 records. (attachment: eval_prompt_set_v1.csv)
- Week 2-3: Integration + ingestion pipeline work (Dev owner).
- Week 4: Parallel runs, quality review session with your SMEs.
- Week 5: Final tuning of prompts/quantization profile + cost/perf report + rollback plan.
- Week 6: Wrap-up, recommendations and next steps for production.

Ownership
- Redwood PM / Sales: Aisha Rahman — overall POC lead, contract coordination.
- Redwood SE: Dev Patel — runtime integration, model routing, and perf tuning.
- Redwood ML Ops: Neha Kapoor — eval harness, metrics, and quality regression checks.
- LumenHealth: Maria (clinical SME) and Carlos (engineering lead) — approve rubric, provide sample data, and validate results.

Attachments: POC_scope_v1.pdf (scope + data requirements), eval_prompt_set_v1.csv (sample prompts and expected outputs).

Asks from LumenHealth to proceed
1) Confirm the model palette above or suggest alternatives (we can swap the primary to a 30B variant if you'd prefer lower cost at some quality tradeoff).
2) Confirm sample data availability and timeline for anonymized 200-record sample.
3) Confirm HIPAA/BAA next steps — please share the contact or specific template for your security team if you have one.

If that looks good I'll tee up an internal kickoff invite with Dev and Neha and send over the BAA + HubSpot deal link. Happy to jump on a short call tomorrow to finalize.

Best,
Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
+a1 (555) 212-3344
aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com

Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC plan: model palette selection & evaluation milestones

Thanks Aisha — really helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side:

- BAA / compliance: we'll need Redwood's SOC2 + HIPAA attestation and a standard BAA. I'll attach our BAA request doc.
- Data sample: we can provide an initial 200-record anonymized dump by EOD Friday (we need to scrub patient identifiers first).
- Quality rubric: Maria will lead SME review; we'll send you a draft rubric by Monday.

One ask on models: our team prefers deterministic outputs for extraction tasks. For the primary model, can you add a note on how you'll ensure consistency (sampling settings, temperature, or use of constrained decoding / schema enforcement)?

Also looping in Carlos — Carlos, can you confirm whether we can accept an external vendor-hosted inference endpoint during the trial (we are okay with US-hosted vendor infra if we have appropriate contractual controls), or do we need on-prem for the first run?

Thanks — attaching our BAA_request.pdf for your legal team.

Regards,
Maria

Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 11:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC plan: model palette selection & evaluation milestones

Hi Maria / team — quick tech notes and how we'll address the determinism / residency asks.

Determinism / extraction consistency
- We'll fix decoding parameters for extraction runs (temperature 0.0, top_p disabled) and use structured output templates with strict parse validation.
- For extra safety we'll run a schema enforcer on the output JSON and fall back to rule-based post-processing for any borderline extraction.

Data residency / hosting
- For the POC we can run on Redwood Hosted US-only region (we'll provide the region and IP blocks for your infra team). If you later need Private (VPC) mode we can stage that as Week 4 cutover.

Integration plan (high-level)
- Week 1: seed eval harness with your 200 anonymized records; run baseline across Llama-3-70B-8bit and Mistral-7B-8bit.
- Week 2: API integration (streaming + batch endpoints), KV cache warm-up for repeated records.
- Week 3: Perf tuning (batching params, quantization profile) and capture latency/cost metrics.

Baseline metrics we'll report (minimum set)
- Semantic accuracy (SME score distribution), precision/recall on structured fields, per-record token cost, median latency, p95 latency, throughput under X concurrency.

Attachments: integration_checklist.md (SE checklist for ingestion, auth, sample payloads).

If LumenHealth wants lower-cost baseline runs we can add a compact mode that routes 20% of calls to Mistral-7B by default and compare quality delta.

I'll open a shared repo with the harness and baseline results once we receive the sample.

Thanks,
Dev
